info.name: Vera Bot — magicpin judge flow
info.description: The judge harness lifecycle as runnable requests with test assertions: warmup, context contract, tick, replay scenarios, teardown. Pick the Local or Live environment, then Run collection.

request.description: Wipes all bot state so the run is repeatable. Against the LIVE bot this is fine before evaluation — never during it.

exec: pm.test('responds well under the 30s judge timeout', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(3000));
